title: Quasi-isomorphism of a normalized dual Koszul comparison
statement: For a commutative ring A, ideal I, and finite Koszul-regular sequence f indexed by Fin r generating I [def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence], every A-linear cochain map from the signed dual Koszul complex [def-sc-koszul-dual-complex] to wedge^r_(A/I) Hom_(A/I)(I/I^2,A/I) concentrated in degree r that satisfies [def-sc-koszul-conormal-comparison] induces isomorphisms on cohomology in every degree.

proof.text: Obtain the conormal basis from exists_koszul_conormal_basis. Reduce QuasiIso to invertibility of the homology map in each degree using quasiIso_iff and quasiIsoAt_iff_isIso_homologyMap. At degree r apply the top comparison calculation with this basis and its specified generating vectors.

For n<r apply the below-top dual Koszul vanishing theorem. For r<n, the exterior-power basis is indexed by n-element subsets of Fin r, an empty type. Its representation is injective into the zero Finsupp module, making the exterior power zero. The dual term is then zero since every linear functional on a zero module is zero. ExactAt.of_isZero and ExactAt.isZero_homology give vanishing of its homology; this part is proved directly in the private Lean helper and requires no regularity.

For n≠r the target single complex has zero homology by isZero_single_obj_homology. A map between zero objects is invertible by IsZero.isIso. These cases supply all homology-map isomorphisms, proving QuasiIso.

theorem koszul_conormal_comparison_is_quasiIso
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    (hreg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsKoszulRegular f) (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = I)
    (φ : koszulDualComplex A r f ⟶
      (HomologicalComplex.single (ModuleCat A) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) r).obj
        (koszulNormalDeterminant A I r))
    (hφ : IsKoszulConormalComparison A I r f hf φ) : QuasiIso φ
